title: Leveraging Predicate and Triplet Learning for Scene Graph Generation
caption: Figure 2. Comparison of different pipelines for relation recog- nition. Previous methods focus on learning predicate cues shared across various triplets with diverse visual appearance. Our method learns and leverages both triplet cues within the same triplet and predicate cues across triplets, to better handle the visual diversity.
